notes: expire_at_ms is the STATED exchange expiration (GD1). The adapter sends stated_s = floor(expire_at_ms / 1000) (R13, GT1).

Realistic/live: lead check at exchange arrival: stated_s x 1000 >= arrival_exchange_ms + 180000, else OrderRejected(GtdLeadTooShort) (GT2). Effective expiry = stated_s x 1000 - 60000 in exchange time (GT3); the simulator expires the order exactly then (OrderDone(Expired, filled)).

ts-compat: decision-time check expire_at_ms >= stamp + 60000 (OrderManager.ts:189, reason gtd_expireAtMs_too_soon(min_offset_ms=60000)); expiry at the first real in-window tick with tick.ts >= expire_at_ms, checked before maker fills on that tick (13 §5.1 WorstQueueCompat); no floor to seconds (R13: n/a).
GD3 / 30 §5: ctx.gtd_expiration(lifetime) = now + gtd_early_expiry + lifetime, the docs' now + 60 + N recipe; in ts-compat gtd_early_expiry is 0 (11 §3 table).
Values in `*_ms` are milliseconds; `arrival` is the exchange-side arrival time of the order.
